::::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8 .inicio-texto}
I am a geographer doing a master's in Geography at the University of Brasília (UnB), Brazil. I study how where people live, and extreme heat, affect their health, using public health data (SUS), maps and spatial analysis. I am a research collaborator at the Laboratory of Geography, Environment and Health (LAGAS/UnB).

#### What I am working on

- [localdatasus](projects/localdatasus/index.qmd): an R package that takes Brazilian health data from the municipality down to the neighborhood.
- [GeoCalor](projects/geocalor/index.qmd): a dashboard on heat waves and health in metropolitan areas, at LAGAS.
- My master's in Geography at UnB.

#### Recent

- *Oct 2026* · localdatasus 0.2.0 submitted to CRAN.
- *Oct 2026* · Tutorial (in Portuguese): [black-and-white academic maps in R](https://hendesson.github.io/tutoriais/mapas-preto-e-branco.html).
- *Sep 2026* · Course: [SQL and PostGIS for health data](projects/postgis-course/index.qmd).

See also my [projects](projects.qmd), [tutorials](tutorials.qmd) and [CV](cv.qmd).
